---
title: Media
---

MEDIA_PAGE_MARKER

Video and embeds have no component in the docs.json-compatible schema — the documented form is
raw HTML, so that is what has to render. MDX treats a lowercase tag as an intrinsic element, so
these reach the page as real `<video>` / `<iframe>` elements.

A self-hosted video in the shape the compatibility target's own guidance prescribes:

<video controls className="w-full aspect-video rounded-xl" src="/videos/demo.mp4"></video>

The autoplay variant, where the boolean attributes are what matter:

<video autoPlay muted loop playsInline className="w-full aspect-video rounded-xl" src="/videos/loop.mp4"></video>

A `<source>` list rather than a `src` — the form the editor deliberately declines to render as a
live player, but which readers must still get:

<video controls className="w-full aspect-video rounded-xl">
  <source src="/videos/demo.webm" type="video/webm" />
  <source src="/videos/demo.mp4" type="video/mp4" />
</video>

A third-party embed, inside a `<Frame>` as the guidance recommends:

<Frame>
  <iframe
    className="w-full aspect-video rounded-xl"
    src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/MEDIA_EMBED_MARKER"
    title="YouTube video player"
    allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture"
    allowFullScreen
  ></iframe>
</Frame>

A GFM task list. `remark-gfm` turns these into real checkbox inputs — the editor now preserves
them too, which it silently did not before (TASK_LIST_MARKER):

- [ ] not done yet
- [x] already done
- a plain bullet in the same list
